Onboarding.WelcomeText: It counts how far your mouse travels on the pad, in real centimeters, even in shooters where the cursor is locked. It runs quietly in the background.
Onboarding.TrayText: AimOdometer lives next to the clock. Hover the icon to see today's distance; click it to open this window.
Onboarding.LanguageText: You can change it any time in Settings.
Onboarding.MouseText: Type the DPI of the mouse you play with (you'll find it in G HUB, Synapse or your mouse's app), or pick a preset. Not sure? Use Measure DPI with a ruler.
Onboarding.DpiHint: Find the DPI in your mouse's software (G HUB, Synapse and others), or measure it with a ruler.
Onboarding.AutostartText: So no session goes uncounted. It uses about 4 MB of memory and no CPU while the mouse is still.
Onboarding.PrivacyNote: Your keyboard is never read. Statistics stay on this PC unless you sign in with Steam later.

Map.Title: Where would you get?
Map.Subtitle: Your mouse distance as a walk along real roads.
Map.ConsentTitle: The map works over the internet
Map.ConsentText: To draw it, AimOdometer loads map tiles from OpenFreeMap, finds cities with Nominatim and builds walking routes with OSRM (all on OpenStreetMap data). These services see your IP address and the cities you look up, nothing else: no statistics, no account. Answers are saved on this PC, so each city and route is requested only once. Everything else in AimOdometer works without the internet.
Map.SearchStart: Where do you start? Type your city and press Enter
Map.SearchMore: Next city on the way: type it and press Enter
Map.SearchFailed: The search service is not reachable. Check the internet connection and try again.
Map.Lead.Week: This week you would have walked
Map.Lead.Month: This month you would have walked
Map.Lead.AllTime: All this time you would have walked

Map.Straight: Part of the way is a straight line: there is no road there, or the route service is not reachable right now.
Map.TilesFailed: The map did not load completely. Check the internet connection.
Map.NoWebGL: This PC cannot draw the map: WebGL is not available (check the graphics driver). Everything else works.
Map.NoRuntime: The map needs Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime, which is missing or broken. Install it from microsoft.com and open the tab again.

Map.SearchOptional: Your own destination (optional): type a city and press Enter
Map.AutoHint: The direction is picked at random among well-known cities. Enter your own destination if you like.

Cloud.Title: Steam account and cloud
Cloud.Pitch: Sign in with Steam to see your statistics from all your PCs in one place. It also unlocks your Steam friends and the world leaderboard. Without signing in, everything keeps working on this PC only.
Cloud.PrivacyHint: You sign in on Steam's own page in your browser: AimOdometer never sees your password. Synced are daily totals per game and mouse, never keystrokes or what you do in games.
Cloud.ContinueInBrowser: Continue in the browser window that just opened: sign in to Steam and confirm. Then come back here.
Cloud.SyncHint: The window syncs when it opens, every 15 minutes while open and when it closes. The background tracker never uses the internet.
Cloud.DeleteConfirm: Delete your AimOdometer account and all statistics in the cloud (from every PC)? Statistics on this PC stay. This cannot be undone.
Cloud.Deleted: The account and its cloud data are deleted.
Cloud.PageSuccessText: You can close this tab and return to AimOdometer.
Cloud.PageFailureText: Close this tab and try again from AimOdometer.
Cloud.Error.Offline: No connection to the AimOdometer cloud. It will try again later.
Cloud.Error.SignInDenied: Steam did not confirm the sign-in. Try again.
Cloud.Error.SignInTimedOut: Sign-in was not finished in time. Try again.
Cloud.Error.BrowserFailed: The browser could not be opened.
Cloud.Error.SessionExpired: You were signed out. Sign in again to keep syncing.
Cloud.Error.TooManyRequests: Too many requests to the cloud. It will try again later.
Cloud.Error.Rejected: The cloud refused the request. Try signing in again.
Cloud.Error.ServerError: The AimOdometer cloud has a problem right now. It will try again later.
Settings.AutoUpdateHint: When the window opens (and every hour while it is open) AimOdometer looks for a new version on GitHub, installs it and restarts. Statistics are never touched.
Update.Restarting: Installing AimOdometer {0}: restarting in a few seconds
Update.DevBuild: This is a developer build: updates come only to installed copies.
Update.Failed: Could not check for updates. Check the internet connection.

Friends.Title: Friends and leaderboards
Friends.Subtitle: Who moves the mouse the most: your Steam friends and the whole world.
Friends.SignInText: Leaderboards need your Steam account: AimOdometer finds which of your Steam friends use it too. Only daily totals are shared, never what you do in games.
Friends.PrivateList: Your Steam friend list is hidden, so AimOdometer cannot see your friends. In Steam: your profile › Edit Profile › Privacy Settings › Friends List: Public. The list is checked again within an hour.
Friends.NobodyYet: None of your Steam friends use AimOdometer yet. Send them the link: once they sign in through Steam, they appear here.
Friends.InviteText: How far does your mouse travel? Try AimOdometer: {0}
Friends.InviteCopied: Link copied. Paste it into a chat.
Friends.WorldOptIn: You are not in the world leaderboard: it is opt-in. Join to see your place among all players (your Steam name, avatar and distance become visible to everyone).
Friends.JoinedWorld: Done. The world leaderboard is recalculated every 15 minutes: you will appear soon.
Friends.WorldNotYet: You will appear in the world leaderboard after your next sync and its next recalculation (every 15 minutes).
Friends.Footer: Week and month follow UTC dates. Who sees you: Settings › Steam account and cloud.
Cloud.ShareWithFriends: My Steam friends who use AimOdometer
Cloud.ShowInWorld: Everyone: take part in the world leaderboard
Cloud.PrivacyHint2: Visible are your Steam name, avatar and distance. The world leaderboard is recalculated every 15 minutes.
Settings.DeleteConfirm: Delete all AimOdometer statistics, settings and achievements on this PC and sign out here? The cloud account is not touched (delete it in the Steam account section). This cannot be undone. AimOdometer will restart.
Feedback.Title: Complaints and suggestions
Feedback.Subtitle: Something broken, a game not detected, an idea? Write it here: the author reads every message.
Feedback.ContactHint: Discord, Telegram or e-mail, if you want an answer.
Feedback.SignedInNote: You are signed in: your Steam name is attached.
Feedback.ThanksText: Your message has been sent to the author.
Feedback.TooShort: Write at least a few words.
Settings.Elevated: Count games that run as administrator (Genshin Impact, Honkai: Star Rail, ZZZ…)
Settings.ElevatedHint: Windows hides the mouse from normal programs while a game running as administrator is in front, so such games show 0 m. With this on, the counter itself runs with administrator rights (Windows asks for permission once). It still only reads the mouse, nothing else.
Settings.ElevatedWorking: Confirm in the Windows window that appeared…
Settings.ElevatedDeclined: Windows did not allow it (the request was declined). Nothing changed.
Settings.ElevatedOn: Done: the counter runs with administrator rights and starts that way with Windows.
Settings.ElevatedOff: Done: the counter runs as a normal program again.
Settings.ElevatedNotRunning: The setting is saved, but the counter did not start. Restart AimOdometer.
App.RecoveredFromBackup: The statistics file was damaged (for example, the PC lost power while it was being written). AimOdometer restored the backup from {0}; distance since then is lost. The damaged file was kept next to it as aimodometer.db.broken-….
App.RecoveredEmpty: The statistics file was damaged (for example, the PC lost power while it was being written) and there was no readable backup, so counting starts again. The damaged file was kept next to it as aimodometer.db.broken-….
Settings.NotificationTestSent: Sent. Nothing appeared? Check Windows Settings › System › Notifications and Do not disturb.
Settings.NotificationTestFailed: The counter is not running, so there is nothing to show the notification.
